event.description: The resulting event with its final start/end and resourceId — a single handler can persist any mutation. For 'delete' it's the removed event.

fromResourceId.description: Set when a drag crossed rows: the row the event came from (reassign).

scope.description: Recurring-series context, set only when the mutation touched a series: 'occurrence' = one occurrence was detached into the standalone override in `event` (id '<seriesId>-x-<occurrenceDate>') — persist it AND add occurrenceDate to the series rrule's exdate list; 'series' = the whole series (event.id is the series id, and event carries its possibly edited or removed rrule).

seriesId.description: The recurring series' base event id (set together with scope).

occurrenceDate.description: Zone-local date 'YYYY-MM-DD' of the touched occurrence (set when scope is 'occurrence').
